parameters.prompt: Stop-motion claymation style: hand-sculpted from matte modeling clay with faint thumbprints, soft rounded chunky forms, bold simple shapes and a clean readable silhouette, saturated slightly chalky colors, from the same world as a gold, crimson and cream 19th-century clay opera house. A cute robot actor. Its head is a big round lime green ball with a large dark screen visor face that shows glowing white LED eyes, one eyebrow cocked at an angle, and a wide toothy grin, two round cream ear pods and a short old-gold collar. A long, straight, sculpted lime nose sticks out under the visor. Its body is round and lime green with a big cream belly that carries a large chunky cream lightning bolt shape. Its arms and legs are thick chunky coil springs, and it wears big chunky dark boots. It gives a confident double thumbs-up. Toy proportions: the head is big, about a third of the character's height, on a short chunky body, and the top of the head is smooth and bare. It stands on a warm wooden stage in front of a softly blurred crimson velvet curtain, in soft warm stage light. Full body, three-quarter front view, the whole character centered and in frame. A single character, no text, no logos.
